fusions.name: Closing Spires
fusions.desc: Spires of stone burst up around you, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bars Slam Shut
fusions.desc: Bars of stone close on an enemy at or below 25% health, dealing 26 damage, leaving it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stone Pen
fusions.desc: Raises a pen of stone 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Sealed Gaol
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. You carry 8% earth resistance.
